title: Verifier-Harness Co-Evolution for Training-Free Self-Improvement on Open-Ended Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.17609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training-free self-improvement lets an agent use feedback to revise the response it is about to return and to update the harness state that shapes how it handles later tasks. On open-ended tasks that feedback rarely comes from reference answers or executable tests, so the agent has to rely on a model-based verifier. When the verifier is wrong, the current response can get worse, and misleading experience can persist across the task stream. A verifier that never changes also grows stale as the agent's responses improve and task demands shift. We introduce Unified Co-Evolution (UCoE), a training-free method that evolves an executable verifier program together with the agent's harness state while all model parameters stay fixed. UCoE synthesizes candidate verifier programs and tests them on response contrasts, pairs of responses that differ in one declared property and have a known preferred side. translated_title: 面向开放式任务免训练自我改进的验证器-执行框架协同进化
translated_abstract: 免训练自我改进使智能体能够利用反馈来修改即将返回的响应，并更新塑造其处理后续任务方式的执行框架状态。在开放式任务上，这种反馈很少来自参考答案或可执行测试，因此智能体不得不依赖基于模型的验证器。当验证器出错时，当前响应可能会变得更糟，且具有误导性的经验可能会在任务流中持续存在。而一成不变的验证器也会随着智能体响应的改进和任务需求的变化而逐渐过时。我们提出了统一协同进化，这是一种免训练方法，在所有模型参数保持固定的情况下，将可执行的验证器程序与智能体的执行框架状态共同进化。UCoE合成候选验证器程序，并在“响应对比”上对它们进行测试——响应对比是指在一个声明属性上不同且已知哪一方更优的响应对。它选择判别能力最强的候选……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出UCoE，一种免训练方法，在模型参数完全固定的情况下，通过在响应对比上评估候选程序，让可执行验证器与智能体的执行框架状态共同进化，从而避免错误验证器导致的响应退化和经验污染，实现开放式任务上的自我改进。
en_tdlr: Proposes UCoE, a training-free method that co-evolves an executable verifier program with the agent's harness state—all model parameters fixed—by testing candidate verifiers on response contrasts, preventing degraded responses and misleading experience caused by stale or wrong verifiers on open-ended tasks.
